rapport_notes: Patient and polite with a customer who was hard to understand at times, but the conversation stayed transactional with little warmth-building beyond basic politeness.
top_strength: Stayed calm and re-confirmed details patiently despite a bad connection and a customer who was hard to follow, without ever making him feel rushed.
coaching_note: Never asked what the customer's biggest concerns were, so there was no discovery moment before quoting and no chance to build trust before the price was on the table.
